title: A Problem, Explained
grammar: Recap: ha clauses and verbs that happen by themselves
goal: I can say what happens if we do or do not take care of nature, using ha.
I can say that something changes by itself with verbs like megújul and eltűnik.
I can talk about pollution with four new words, such as vízszennyezés and erdőirtás.
I can say what a természetvédelmi terület is.
